title: SAG employees’ work stoppage at Paso Los Libertadores over staffing
reason: The opened report describes a work stoppage and a negotiated staffing table but no public gathering, march or crowd. The figures of 15 employees on site and 40 needed describe staffing, not protest attendance. No evidence establishes a qualifying 50-person public action.
notes: The exclusion applies to the reported stoppage at this checkpoint only and is not a claim that no other SAG or public-sector protest occurred. The source says the stoppage ended after a negotiating table was established.
